item.title: LIVE: Memorial services for Rev. Jesse Jackson continue Friday in Chicago
item.description: Memorial services continue Friday in Chicago to honor the life of civil rights icon Rev. Jesse Jackson.

item.title: Man arrested for pointing gun at driver in road rage incident, constable says
item.description: A man was arrested after being accused of pointing a gun at a driver in a road rage incident in northwest Harris County.

item.title: Houston ISD votes to close 12 schools, including historic Burrus Elementary
item.description: Houston ISD’s board voted unanimously to close 12 campuses, including Burrus Elementary, a historic school in Independence Heights. Community members say the move erases history.

item.title: TxDOT announces weekend closure on southbound I-69 for Brazos River Bridge project
item.description: Weekend closure on southbound I-69 in Sugar Land, Texas due to Brazos River Bridge project. Plan ahead for extra travel time.

item.title: Man charged in deadly shooting of man at Willowbrook apartment, HPD says
item.description: Police have arrested a man in connection with the shooting death of a 52-year-old man at an apartment complex in Willowbrook this week.

item.title: Bill Clinton to sit for closed-door deposition in Epstein investigation
item.description: Former President Bill Clinton will appear for a closed-door deposition before the House Oversight Committee on Friday, a day after former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton gave her testimony amid the committee's probe of convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Trump calls out to Texas GOP Senate candidates, stops short of endorsement
item.description: President Trump gave shoutouts to the three Republicans running the Texas Senate primary race during a speech in which they were all in attendance in Corpus Christi on Friday, but he stopped short of endorsing in the race. “We have a great Attorney General Ken Paxton. Where’s Ken? Hi, Ken,” Trump said during his remarks. [...]

item.title: 3 detention officers charged with assault of an inmate, HCSO says
item.description: Three detention officers with the Harris County Sheriff’s Office have been charged with misdemeanor assault charges for an incident in 2024, deputies said.

item.title: LULAC cancels Houston's Cinco de Mayo parade due to ICE enforcement concerns
item.description: The 2026 Cinco De Mayo parade in Houston has been cancelled by community leaders due to concerns over immigration enforcement activity in the area.

item.title: Black Trail Riders take center stage at Houston's Rodeo Parade
item.description: Black cowboys and cowgirls from the True Western Trail Ride Association made a stop at the Delmar Stadium in Houston to remind people that Western history is more diverse than many realize, before continuing their journey to the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Parade.
